title: Cyto-Genotoxic Assessment of Sulfoxaflor in Allium cepa Root Cells and DNA Docking Studies.
authors: Liman, Recep; Ali, Muhammad Muddassir; Istifli, Erman Salih; Cigerci, Ibrahim Hakki; Tinaz, Umran; Kirlangic, Sidal; Altay, Nejla; Ugur, Yudum Yeltekin
one_liner_zh: 该研究评估杀虫剂Sulfoxaflor在洋葱根细胞中的细胞遗传毒性，并通过分子对接模拟其与DNA小沟的结合，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作（此处为小分子-DNA）且方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究，但对象非TF-DNA体系。
abstract: Sulfoxaflor (SFX) is an insecticide that is commonly used for the control of sap-feeding insects. Since SFX is extensively applied globally, it has been implicated in the substantial induction of environmental toxicity. Therefore, in this study, Allium cepa roots have been employed to elucidate the potential cytogenotoxic effects of SFX in non-target cells by examination of mitotic index (MI), chromosomal aberrations (CAs), and DNA damage. Physiological effects of SFX were evaluated by A. cepa root growth inhibition assay, while cytogenotoxic effects were assessed by A. cepa ana-telophase and comet assay. Moreover, DNA binding affinity and binding mode of SFX were examined using molecular docking simulations to shed light on the genotoxic mechanism of action. The half maximal effective concentration (EC(50)) on the growth of A. cepa cells calculated for SFX was found as 500 mg/L. Moreover, dose- and time-dependent decrease in MI, increase in CAs (disturbed ana-telophase, chromosomal laggards, stickiness, and anaphase chromosome bridge) and DNA damage were observed by the exposure of A. cepa root tips to SFX after 24-, 48-, 72-, and 96-h treatment periods. A 6-bp double-stranded DNA structure containing two intercalation sites (PDB ID: 1Z3F) was used for docking studies. According to DNA docking results, SFX exhibited an energetically more favorable binding affinity with DNA (DeltaG = -5.05 kcal/mol) compared with the experimental mutagen methyl methanesulfonate (MMS) (DeltaG = -2.94 kcal/mol), and preferentially snugly fits into the minor groove of DNA possessing an intercalation gap, thus, providing valuable mechanistic data into the formation of chromosome aberrations and DNA fragmentation induced by this pesticide in A. cepa.
abstract_zh: 氟啶虫胺腈（Sulfoxaflor, SFX）是一种常用于防治刺吸式口器害虫的杀虫剂。由于SFX在全球范围内广泛使用，其已被认为与环境毒性的显著诱导有关。因此，本研究采用洋葱（Allium cepa）根部，通过检测有丝分裂指数（mitotic index, MI）、染色体畸变（chromosomal aberrations, CAs）和DNA损伤，来阐明SFX在非靶细胞中的潜在细胞遗传毒性效应。SFX的生理效应通过A. cepa根部生长抑制试验评估，而细胞遗传毒性效应则通过A. cepa后期-末期（ana-telophase）和彗星试验（comet assay）评估。此外，利用分子对接模拟（molecular docking simulations）检测了SFX的DNA结合亲和力及结合模式，以揭示其遗传毒性作用机制。计算得出SFX对A. cepa细胞生长的半数有效浓度（EC(50)）为500 mg/L。此外，在24、48、72和96小时处理期间，A. cepa根尖暴露于SFX后，观察到MI呈剂量和时间依赖性降低，CAs（包括紊乱的后期-末期、染色体滞后、粘着和后期染色体桥）及DNA损伤增加。对接研究使用了包含两个嵌入位点（PDB ID: 1Z3F）的6-bp双链DNA结构。根据DNA对接结果，与实验性诱变剂甲基磺酸甲酯（methyl methanesulfonate, MMS）（DeltaG = -2.94 kcal/mol）相比，SFX与DNA表现出能量上更有利的结合亲和力（DeltaG = -5.05 kcal/mol），并优先紧密嵌入DNA的小沟中，且具有嵌入间隙，从而为该农药在A. cepa中诱导的染色体畸变和DNA片段化形成提供了有价值的机制性数据。
